resources.string: Off by default. When enabled, available coordinates and reported accuracy travel in production metadata, including when that metadata is shared. Location permission alone does not enable recording. Disabling this option leaves previous captures unchanged. Presets never change this choice. Location is requested only while the app is in the foreground.
Android location access: approximate. Approximate location is supported.
Android location access: precise. This permission does not guarantee physical accuracy.
Location recording is off. New captures omit capture geolocation.
Location recording is enabled, but Android access is missing. New captures record the unavailable status, without coordinates.
A recent location is available. Each capture records availability and reported accuracy at admission.
Location access is inactive. New captures omit coordinates while inactive.
Waiting for a location. New captures omit coordinates while no location is available.
The last location is too old. New captures omit coordinates until a recent location is available.
Location access was not granted. You can request it again; if Android no longer shows a prompt, change location access in system app settings. Your recording choice has not changed.
